data.name: Joud
data.gender_notes: Joud is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'juda' meaning to give or provide. The name Joud is given to a child born into a family known for its generosity and abundance. The name Joud carries the meaning “Generosity, abundance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Joud usually hope their child will grow to embody generosity, abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying Allah's blessings and generosity
data.etymology: Joud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generosity, abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joud total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: جود
in_arabic.meaning: جود تعني الكرم و السخاء و العطاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جود مشتق من جذر ثلاثي هو ج-و-د، و معناه الكرم و السخاء و العطاء بدون مقابل، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران آية 159 و في سورة الفجر آية 16، و يدل على صفة جميلة في الشخص تتمثل في رغبته في مساعدة الآخرين و إعطائهم دون انتظار شيء في المقابل.

in_urdu.name: جود
in_urdu.meaning: جود کا مطلب ہے کرم، سخاوت، اور بے منت اعطا کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جود نام کی اصل عربی زبان سے ہے، جہاں اس کا جڑ ثلاثی ج-و-د ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے کرم، سخاوت، اور بے منت اعطا کرنا۔ قرآن کریم میں آل عمران کی آیت 159 اور الفجر کی آیت 16 میں اس کا ذکر آیا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک اچھی صفت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، جہاں انسان کو بے لوث دل سے دوسروں کی مدد کرنے اور ان کو دینے کی خواہش ہوتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जौद
in_hindi.meaning: जौद का अर्थ है दान, उदारता, और बिना किसी अपेक्षा के देना
in_hindi.long_meaning: जौद नाम की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी भाषाओं से हुई है। इसका त्रिभुज मूल ज-व-द है, जिसका अर्थ है दान, उदारता, और बिना किसी अपेक्षा के देना। कुरआन में सूरह آل-ए-इमरान आयत 159 और सूरह अल-फज्र आयत 16 में इसका उल्लेख है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में एक अच्छे गुण की ओर संकेत करता है, जहां व्यक्ति बे-लोथ दिल से दूसरों की मदद करने और देने की इच्छा रखता है।

in_pashto.name: جود
in_pashto.meaning: د جود مطلب د کرم، سخاوت، او بې پرته ورکړه ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: د جود نوم اصل عربي ژبه څخه ده، چیرته چې د هغې درې ګونی ريښه ج-و-د ده. د دې معنی ده کرم، سخاوت، او بې پرته ورکړه. په قرآن کريم کې د آل عمران په 159 آيت او د الفجر په 16 آيت کې يې ذکر شوی دی. دا نوم د اسلامي پېژندګلۍ کې د يو ښه صفت نښه ده، چيرته چې سړی بې لوثه زړه له نورو سره مرسته کوي او هغوی ته ورکوي.

in_english.name: Joud
in_english.meaning: Joud means generosity, kindness, and giving without expecting anything in return
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joud originates from the Arabic root 'j-w-d', which signifies generosity, kindness, and giving without expecting anything in return. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al Imran, verse 159, and Surah Al Fajar, verse 16. This name represents a beautiful trait in Islamic tradition, where an individual has a desire to help others and give to them without expecting anything in return, reflecting a spirit of selflessness and compassion.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل جود دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Joud holds a significant cultural impact as it emphasizes the importance of generosity and hospitality in Islamic culture. This name would be lovingly given to a child in the hope that they will embody the virtues of kindness, compassion, and selflessness towards others. The naming practice serves as a reminder for the child and their community to strive towards acts of kindness and giving, cultivating a heart of compassionate service and love for all.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Joud symbolizes the concept of giving and provision from God, acknowledging and giving thanks for His boundless generosity. It holds a reminder of God's promise of abundance and provision in the Quran: "And if you should count the blessings of God, never could you number them. Verily God is Forgiving, Merciful." (Quran 14:32). The name serves as a constant reminder for the bearer to seek God's guidance and provisions in their lives while striving to embody His qualities by being a generous and caring soul to others.
